recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless a future THO review finds a current terminology.hl7.org OID error, which should be handled in THO/UTG rather than this core page.
issue_request: FHIR-13325 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 correction asking the terminology systems page V3 tab to show complete V3 code-system OIDs; ActCode should show 2.16.840.1.113883.5.4 rather than .1.113883.5.4.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn revision 12612, represented in git by 278f5d78391ee233bee1d8d50b2a9305e3244def, which removed the publisher-side oid.substring(8) truncation from the V3 code-system index rendering path.
additional_context: The current source/terminologies-systems.html page is still active in publish.ini, but commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 removed the V3 and V2 tabs from core while moving UTG/THO terminology content out of the FHIR-core build. The current page directs readers to published THO and THO CI for code systems not listed in core, and THO's v3-ActCode artifact carries the complete urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.4 identifier.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current core source has no truncated urn:oid:.1.113883 ActCode pattern and no core-generated V3 OID table needing correction.
